effect: The replies confirm the water and food deliveries and give Eli an authorized collection option; unfinished work remains visible. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The distinction between an available solution and a completed job is satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reviewing Moth's proposed rounds with the neighbors was most worthwhile: the volunteers identified a two-person carry and chose a different priority.

leastWorthwhile.text: The dispatch-to-desk sequence felt somewhat procedural, though the readback had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: Moth's distance-based route quietly put the upstairs water request last, turning a routing choice into a priority decision.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; even the dispatch readback served a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the tension between the slow appeal and the community's immediate response makes me curious what happens after dawn.
